resolver_failure_modes.note: A note that names more than one resolvable tree is the resolver's main exposure. The tie is broken by preferring a same-cohort citation and then the highest published score, which is the tree a solver is most likely to have forked. That heuristic is unverifiable per row. It was checked on the two hardest control cases in R-B, a4ac742e -> 48423d09 and e987b29b -> 51b9bf85, and it got both right, but 362 rows depend on it and no per-row proof exists.
